app.name: Kavach
app.tagline: When the internet dies, the information must still arrive.
status.label: Connection
status.live.desc: Connected. Live alerts and maps are updating.
status.degraded.desc: Slow or unstable connection. Showing saved data while retrying.
status.cellular.desc: Metered mobile data. Text and QR only, map tiles paused.
status.offline.desc: No network. Using the preloaded Kavach pack on this device.
status.relay.desc: No data. Add alerts by SMS, QR code or share sheet.
lang.label: Language
page.home.title: Home
page.home.intro: Kavach keeps verified, translated crisis alerts working even when the network does not.
home.promise.heading: What works offline
home.signed.title: Signed alerts
home.signed.desc: Official warnings are cryptographically signed and verified on your device — no server needed to trust them.
home.nodata.title: Works with no data
home.nodata.desc: The map, shelters and first-aid guide are stored on the device before you need them.
home.noinstall.title: Nothing to install
home.noinstall.desc: Scan a QR code at your hotel or airport. It runs in the browser and saves itself.
home.relay.title: Relay mode
home.relay.desc: Even with zero data, alerts arrive over SMS or a shared QR code and stay verifiable.
page.alerts.title: Alerts
page.alerts.intro: Signed official alerts. Arriving in M4 and M7.
page.map.title: Map
page.map.intro: Shelters, hospitals and hazard zones — offline. Arriving in M8.
page.assist.title: Assist
page.assist.intro: Grounded answers, never invented. Arriving in M10.
page.aid.title: First aid & SOS
page.aid.intro: First-aid steps, medical ID and one-tap SOS. Arriving in M10.
page.phrases.title: Phrasebook
page.phrases.intro: Show-a-local cards with read-aloud. Arriving in M10.
page.me.title: Me
page.me.intro: Medical ID, check-ins and settings. Arriving in M9 and M10.
page.report.title: Report a hazard
page.report.intro: Community reports are never official alerts. Arriving in M9.
page.authority.title: Authority console
page.authority.intro: Issue signed alerts and drills. Arriving in M6.
page.packet.title: Alert packet
page.packet.empty: No packet in this link. Open a link shared by an authority, or scan the QR code, to see a verified alert here.
page.packet.m4note: In M4 this screen will decode the packet, verify its ECDSA P-256 signature against the bundled public key, check expiry, and render the hazard in your chosen language — all offline.
page.authority.heading: Sign, issue, and label honestly
page.authority.signing: Alerts issued here are signed with ECDSA P-256 on the server. The private key never leaves Supabase secrets. Every alert this console produces is verifiable offline by any tourist device.
page.authority.drill: Because real disasters cannot be summoned during a demo, this console has a clearly labelled DRILL mode. Drills are watermarked in the UI and in the signed packet itself. Nothing fake is ever shown as real.
ui.offlineNotice: You are offline. This screen uses data stored on your device.
ready.title: Get Kavach ready
ready.intro: Set this up once, while you have Wi-Fi. After that Kavach works with no signal at all.
ready.step1Body: Shelters, hospitals, roads, zones and first-aid guides are stored on this phone so they load with no network.
ready.step2Body: Kavach downloads English plus your chosen language. You can change this later.
ready.step3Title: Add it to your home screen
ready.step3Body: No app store and no install. Kavach opens like a normal app, full screen, with a tap.
ready.storageLocal: Everything stays on this device. Medical ID is never uploaded.
ready.storageDelete: You can delete it all at any time from Settings.
ready.error: Could not download the offline pack.
ready.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
ready.iosStep3: Tap Add. Kavach then opens full screen, like an app.
ready.installGeneric: Use your browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
works.all: Everything, including live alerts and maps.
works.cached: Saved alerts and maps. Live updates may lag.
works.sms: Alerts by SMS, QR code or the share sheet.
works.offlineMap: The offline map and hazard zones.
works.localOnly: First aid, phrasebook and one-tap SOS.
update.available: A new version of Kavach is ready
update.body: Update when you are safe to. Nothing is lost if you wait.
update.title: Update available
update.newVersion: A newer version of Kavach has been downloaded.
status.neverReached: This device has not reached the network yet.
home.packReady: Offline pack saved on this device ({version}).
home.packNotReady: Offline pack is not downloaded yet — open Get Ready.
